name: Risers and J-tubes for pipelines and subsea cables
description: ESDEP defines a pipeline riser as the piping rising from seabed to topside level and describes conductors as protecting and guiding the drill string from topside to 40-100 m below the seabed. US5513929A describes conventional casing guides and tensioned-casing production risers; US4679964A shows a prefabricated riser pipe from a conductor-mounted miniplatform to a remote flowline. At Anjung Kecil a 1.26 km dynamic subsea power cable links the FPSO to the wellhead platform. No page read during th
aliases: Risers and J-tubes for pipelines and subsea cables

specifications.metric: Pipeline riser / conductor-guided riser — Conductor depth below seabed
specifications.basis: ESDEP 15A.1 glossary, "CONDUCTORS": tubular protecting and guiding the drill string from topside down to 40 to 100 m under the sea bottom.

specifications.metric: Pipeline riser / conductor-guided riser — Conventional conductor diameter examples
specifications.basis: US5513929A background: conductors "usually from twenty-four to thirty inches" in diameter.

specifications.metric: Pipeline riser / conductor-guided riser — Sump / discharge pipe depth below water level
specifications.basis: ESDEP 15A.1 glossary, "SUMPS": vertical pipes from topside down to 5-10 m below water level for intake or discharge.

specifications.metric: Dynamic subsea power cable (FPSO to WHP) — Dynamic subsea power cable length
specifications.basis: Offshore Technology Anjung Kecil: "A 1.26km-long dynamic subsea power cable will be laid between the FPSO and the well-head platform as part of the field modification plan".

specifications.metric: Reliability — Dynamic analysis trigger for slender members and conductors
specifications.basis: ESDEP 15A.1 section 8.1: dynamic analysis if natural period exceeds 3 seconds; slender jacket members and conductors listed as locally dynamic.
